title: InterHier: Learning Interconnected Hierarchical Semantics for Open-Vocabulary Object Detection
description: A question counts as answered at rank r if the r-th retrieved chunk contains ANY of its evidence phrases (case and whitespace insensitive). Evidence phrases are copied from the PDF's own text, not from the parser output, so text lost by the parser shows up as a miss. Questions with no evidence are not answered by the paper; they are used to choose the relevance threshold.
